newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tupras to open hydrocracker plant.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tupras to open hydrocracker plant.

text.p: Turkish state oil refiner Tupras said it would inaugurate a $380 million hydrocracker and continuous catalytic reformer (CCR) complex at its northwestern Izmit refinery on Friday.
Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller will attend Friday's opening ceremony for the complex, which was built to complement the company's refineries in Izmir and Kirikkale.

Tupras general manager Ergun Kuran was quoted in a statement as saying the company's investment plans to the year 2003, aimed at facilitating competition with refineries in Europe, would be half finished with the plant's inauguration.
"With the opening of this complex, we have completed a $1 billion portion of our $2 billion investment master plan," he said.

He said the plant would produce annually 1.1 million tonnes of low grade fuel oil, 21,000 tonnes of liquid petroleum gas, 313,000 tonnes of naphta, 243,000 tonnes of jet fuel and 368,000 tonnes of engine oil.
